svg.title: The study desk around the search. Focus timer: 25 or 50 minute focus and 5 or 15 minute break modes, labelled with your topic; it keeps a 7 day chart, a daily streak and a session log, and shows a notification when time is up. Reading list: save papers from search results, or paste a DOI to see the paper's details and copy an APA 7 citation. Study tasks you can tick off. My shelf: links and files you open often. Scratchpad: notes that save as you type and export to Markdown.
